=== cluster_vf
Vagrant.configure("2") do |config|
  config.vm.box = "sre/debian13"

  (1..2).each do |i|
    config.vm.define "app#{i}" do |app|
      app.vm.hostname = "app#{i}"
      app.vm.network "private_network", ip: "192.168.158.#{10 + i}"
      app.vm.provision "shell", run: "always", inline: <<~SHELL
        hostname > /var/www/html/index.html
        rm -f /var/www/html/index.nginx-debian.html
        pgrep -x nginx >/dev/null || nginx
      SHELL
    end
  end

  config.vm.define "lb" do |lb|
    lb.vm.hostname = "lb"
    lb.vm.network "private_network", ip: "192.168.158.10"
    lb.vm.network "forwarded_port", guest: 80, host: 8857
    lb.vm.provision "shell", run: "always", inline: <<~SHELL
      cat > /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default <<'EOF'
      upstream apps {
          server 192.168.158.11;
          server 192.168.158.12;
      }
      server {
          listen 80;
          location / { proxy_pass http://apps; }
      }
      EOF
      nginx -t && (nginx -s reload 2>/dev/null || nginx)
    SHELL
  end
end

Vagrant.configure("2") do |config|
  config.vm.box = "sre/debian13"

  config.trigger.after :up do |t|
    t.info = "machine démarrée"
    t.ruby do |env, machine|
      File.open(File.join(__dir__, "up.log"), "a") do |f|
        f.puts "#{Time.now.to_i} #{machine.name} #{machine.id}"
      end
    end
  end

  config.trigger.after :up do |t|
    t.run_remote = { inline: "date +%s > /etc/vagrant-up" }
  end

  ["build", "test"].each do |name|
    config.vm.define name do |m|
      m.vm.hostname = name
    end
  end
end
